- Bansal, R., D. Kiku, and A. Yaron, 2016, *Risks for the long run:
  Estimation with time aggregation*, Journal of Monetary Economics 82,
  52 to 69.
  [Author PDF](https://people.duke.edu/~rb7/bio/bansal_kiku_yaron_jme.pdf)
- Bansal, R., and A. Yaron, 2004, *Risks for the Long Run: A Potential
  Resolution of Asset Pricing Puzzles*, Journal of Finance 59(4),
  1481 to 1509.
  [Published version](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/j.1540-6261.2004.00670.x)
- Campbell, J. Y., and J. H. Cochrane, 1999, *By Force of Habit: A
  Consumption-Based Explanation of Aggregate Stock Market Behavior*,
  Journal of Political Economy 107(2), 205 to 251.
  [Published version](https://doi.org/10.1086/250059)
- Campbell, J. Y., and R. J. Shiller, 1988, *The Dividend-Price Ratio
  and Expectations of Future Dividends and Discount Factors*, Review of
  Financial Studies 1(3), 195 to 228.
  [Published version](https://doi.org/10.1093/rfs/1.3.195)
- Cochrane, J. H., *Asset Pricing*, revised edition, Princeton
  University Press, 2005.
  [Author's page with the free draft](https://www.johnhcochrane.com/asset-pricing)
- Epstein, L. G., and S. E. Zin, 1989, *Substitution, Risk Aversion,
  and the Temporal Behavior of Consumption and Asset Returns I: A
  Theoretical Framework*, Econometrica 57(4), 937 to 969.
  [JSTOR](https://www.jstor.org/stable/1913778)
- Hansen, L. P., 1982, *Large Sample Properties of Generalized Method
  of Moments Estimators*, Econometrica 50(4), 1029 to 1054.
  [JSTOR](https://www.jstor.org/stable/1912775)
- Hansen, L. P., and R. Jagannathan, 1991, *Implications of Security
  Market Data for Models of Dynamic Economies*, Journal of Political
  Economy 99(2), 225 to 262.
  [JSTOR](https://www.jstor.org/stable/2937681)
- Kiku, D., 2006, *Long-Term Risks in the Aggregate and Cross-Section
  of Stock Returns*, working paper, The Wharton School, University of
  Pennsylvania. Replication: this repository.
- Mehra, R., and E. C. Prescott, 1985, *The Equity Premium: A Puzzle*,
  Journal of Monetary Economics 15(2), 145 to 161.
  [Published version](https://doi.org/10.1016/0304-3932(85)90061-3)
- Tauchen, G., and R. Hussey, 1991, *Quadrature-Based Methods for
  Obtaining Approximate Solutions to Nonlinear Asset Pricing Models*,
  Econometrica 59(2), 371 to 396.
  [JSTOR](https://www.jstor.org/stable/2938261)

In-text citations across the site link to the list above, and a few
references named on individual pages, e.g., Fama and French on the
sort and Weil on the preferences, are cited on the page that uses
them.
